text:
Type: minimalist open coffee table
Use: holding drinks, books and decor in front of a sofa; living room
Style: minimalist, modern, contemporary
Materials: engineered wood, wenge laminate finish
Colors: dark chocolate brown
Shape: low rectangle, flat top over a lower shelf, slab panel supports at ends and center, no legs, compact and boxy
Feel: clean, simple, grounded
Goes with: white or light grey sofas, light rugs, white walls; minimalist or modern living rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand - Solimo Essential Engineered Wood Coffee Table (Wenge Finish)
product.description: Sturdy structure made of premium quality engineered wood Made from European standard particle board to ensure durability Spacious table top and shelves, for placing magazines, ornaments, etc. Aesthetic, easy-to-clean design with smooth edges diminish chances of scrapes and cuts Rigorously tested for safety and quality, underwent 15+ safety and quality checks Long-lasting table resistant to humidity, stains and hot water Includes a 3-year warranty on manufacturing defects
